# Self-awareness of accuracy

**Knowing when you're right.** Evidence: **experimental**. In the overall score: no. Sky group: style. Frameworks: metacognition.

| Game | Paradigm | Loading | Origin | Reliability | Scoring | Metrics | Playable |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| How sure are you? (`how_sure`) | Confidence ratings | 1 | classic | 1 | calibration | calibration_error, brier_score | no |

## Scoring

- Main metric: Calibration error, Brier score.
- Not an ability estimate: its games are scored as calibration, so it never enters the skill scale.
- Raw trials are stored, so rounds can be re-scored later.

## Uncertainty

- Not on the skill scale; shown with its own range where it is shown.
